build.name: ./Configure && make gp (readline/gmp optional)
build.cmd: ./Configure >/dev/null 2>&1 && make -s gp 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; B=$(find . -name gp-dyn -type f -perm -u+x | head -1); echo BIN=$B; test -n "$B"

runs.name: number theory: factor a Mersenne number, an elliptic-curve point count, a class number, the 1000th prime -- exact, against known values
runs.cmd: B=$(find . -name gp-dyn -type f -perm -u+x | head -1); LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$(dirname $B) $B -q < $HARNESS/nt.gp 2>&1 | tail -8

notes: Oracle: known number-theoretic values -- 2^67-1 = 193707721 * 761838257287 (Cole 1903); prime(1000) = 7919; ellap of a named curve; a class number. Exact arithmetic on the PARI stack; gp built from source (readline/gmp optional, bundled fallback).
